en.t: Genji came in person to open the lattice window.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得不宜太近，连忙退向一旁。

en.t: Yugiri felt it would be improper to stand too close, and quickly withdrew to one side.

units.source_text: 源氏见了夕雾，便问：“怎么样？

en.t: When Genji saw Yugiri, he asked, "How was it?

units.source_text: 昨夜你去陪伴太君，她一定很高兴吧？”

en.t: You went to keep the lady company last night, so she must have been very pleased, was she not?"

units.source_text: 太君遇到一点儿事情，就淌眼泪，真可怜啊！”

en.t: At the slightest thing, the lady sheds tears. It is truly pitiful!"

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“太君春秋已高，在世之日无多了。

en.t: Genji laughed and said, "The lady is already advanced in years, and she has little time left in this world.
You should serve her with wholehearted filial devotion.

units.source_text: 内大臣对她照顾不周，她常常诉苦呢。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior does not care for her properly, and she often complains of it.

units.source_text: 内大臣极爱体面，喜欢豪华阔绰。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior cares greatly about appearances and likes splendor and extravagance.

units.source_text: 因此他的孝行也注重表面堂皇，欲使见者吃惊赞叹。

en.t: For that reason, even his filial acts emphasize outward magnificence, meant to astonish and impress those who see them.
Yet they lack deep and sincere filial feeling.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，他心中毕竟见识丰富，是个非常贤明的人。

en.t: Even so, he is, after all, a man of broad judgment and great wisdom.

units.source_text: 在这江河日下的末世，他的才学可说是优秀无比的了。

en.t: In this declining latter age, his learning and ability may be called unsurpassed.

units.source_text: 做一个人，要全无缺点，是很难的。”

en.t: For any person to be entirely without faults is very difficult."
